}}'''Frask Taglien''' is the husband of [[Lind Taglien]], innkeeper of [[The Great Gathering]] at the Black Tower.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Frask Taglien}}

==Activities==
Lind and Frask run the Great Gathering inn in the Black Tower. They help Androl and his friends when the Taim's cronies bullied them.

==Trivia==
Named after Frank Taglieri, real-life husband of Linda Taglieri, creator of the Thirteenth Depository blog.
